overview_description.description: Re:Schedule integrates the meetings in your calendar with agendas, notes, and tasks. With Re:Schedule, all the information you need to run your meetings is just a tap away, in your calendar. Re:Schedule makes it easy to prepare for meetings, lead productive discussions & track meeting results. Each meeting in Re:Schedule has a shared workspace for real-time collaboration with your team. Re:Schedule syncs with your Google Calendar. Available on iPad and Mac.
